in_hebrew.name: יָרָה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: A name derived from the Hebrew word יָרָה (yarah) meaning 'a thicket, a thick growth'. It may have been given to someone who lived near a thicket or forest, or it could be a metonymic name for someone who was strong and protective, like a forest.

in_greek.name: Ιαρρώς
in_greek.long_meaning: The Greek form of the name Jarrow is Ιαρρώς (Iarros). The origin and meaning of this name in Greek are unclear, as it is not attested in the Septuagint or any other ancient Greek sources.

in_latin.name: Iarrous
in_latin.long_meaning: The Latin form of the name Jarrow is Iarrous. Like the Greek form, the origin and meaning of this name in Latin are uncertain, as it is not attested in any ancient Latin sources.
